verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago ships a first-party MCP server and a Claude Code plugin, so an AI agent in the developer's IDE can carry out natural-language requests such as creating test users, managing their funds, and configuring and monitoring webhooks. The natural-language layer comes from the host agent, and the documented operations cover developer and test tasks rather than full account operation. The MP CLI is token-driven command-line access, not natural language. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface inside the product itself, MCP coverage of live production operations (payments, subscriptions, reports), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Create test users and manage their funds to validate payment flows.
